data.summary: ❖ Full Stack Developer and Lead Engineer with around 12 years in web development, consistently achieving milestones within demanding timelines and delivering tailored products to both B2B and B2C users. ❖ Proficient in diverse tech stack, specializing in backend development worked in E-commerce, Fantasy Gaming, HealthCare-Life Sciences, and Stock Trading domains. ❖ I’m excited about the opportunities that lie ahead and look forward to collaborating on new projects that challenge me to innovate and create meaningful solutions in the world of Development.

responsibilities: Led the decomposition of a monolithic NestJS application into two independent microservices, collaborating with a team of 5–10 developers to define service boundaries, migrate APIs, separate infrastructure components, and optimize system architecture.

I have been working on REST api/s using Nestjs for Kornferry. Created a node npm package for Amqp protocol which provides auto reconnection to AWS RabbitMQ instance via secret manager and app config, also provisions connection and channel pooling with customisable pools and publishing and subscribing to queues and exchanges.
Designed and developed a Notification Platform using NestJS, RabbitMQ, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Novu, including Notification API and Worker Services for real-time enterprise notifications.

Architected and implemented shared internal npm packages for RabbitMQ messaging, notification integrations, logging, and Redis caching; published reusable frameworks to JFrog Artifactory and consumed across services.

Designed PostgreSQL schemas and ETL workflows using Apache NiFi, RabbitMQ, for notification subscriber, subscription, topic, audit, and data management supporting both historical and incremental data loads.
Optimized slow APIs and database workloads through Query refactoring, CTE optimization, Join optimization, Index tuning, Composite index design, Execution plan analysis and Redis caching strategies.

Designed and implemented an AI-powered document intelligence module using NestJS, AWS Bedrock, RAG, MongoDB Vector Search, and React, enabling natural language search and contextual question-answering across enterprise documents.

Built scalable document ingestion pipelines using Apache NiFi, Amazon S3, RabbitMQ (Amazon MQ), and asynchronous workers for document extraction, chunking, metadata enrichment, embedding generation, and vector indexing.

Integrated LLM capabilities through AWS Bedrock, leveraging retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns, semantic search, prompt engineering, and context-aware response generation to improve answer accuracy and reduce hallucinations.

Leveraged Cursor IDE, Claude, GitHub Copilot, and agentic AI workflows for code analysis, performance optimization, cacheability assessments, code generation, and engineering productivity improvements.
Collect and understand the requirements of features from the Client, team leads and technical architects.
Develop REST APIs related to the application and improve performance through query tuning, indexing strategies, Redis caching, and event-driven processing patterns.

Mentored junior developers, conducted architecture reviews and PR reviews, contributed to sprint planning and estimations, and authored technical documentation for platform components and integrations.
Write technical documentation for the product and the features.
Contributed to project planning, story creation, and timeline estimations.
Led the development of NEMO trading domain application with a team of 10-15 developers, ensuring proper code structuring and optimization, security, and compatibility across various platforms.
Enhanced TypeScript programming standards, according to client specifications and increased code coverage to 85-95% through written unit tests.
Design an AWS orchestration and microservices from the requirements.
Design Database schema and develop REST APIs related to the feature.
Worked on AWS serverless, handled various AWS processes and microservices built upon various services.
Created a reporting, deposits, and withdrawal system.
technologies: AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, SNS, SQS, SSM, SES, API Gateway, Step Functions)

responsibilities: Simplified client requirements into actionable steps for software developers by leading a team of 15-20.

Spearheaded the development of THREAD data export and study creation modules, a game-changing clinical research platform utilizing a multi-tenant architecture and microservices for the healthcare and life sciences industry.
technologies: AWS (Cognito, Lambda, EC2, S3, SNS, SQS, SSM, API Gateway, Step Functions)

responsibilities: Analyzed Ballebaazi.com Fantasy Gaming application, identifying critical requirements, and enhancing user experience, leading to a 25% rise in user engagement and 15% design improvement.
Developed backend components for Barrel13, the Google Chrome Extension for Amazon Products Analytics and worked on Taxbuddy admin features to enhance the tax preparation module.
Led development and implementation of Pacific Freedom.
Successfully executed Holisticfamilysolutions.com, enhancing user experience and engagement.
Revamped Mmcomics.com by implementing a robust E-commerce platform, culminating in a 40% increase in online sales and a 25% reduction in cart abandonment rate.
Engineered Prime Time Sports, optimizing product sales and administration.
Cultivated and strengthened client relationships on Fwlli.com by introducing a comprehensive reporting admin dashboard, resulting in a 20% increase in customer retention.
Proficiently implemented payment gateway integration in various E-commerce platforms, achieving 35% efficiency gains and a 25% revenue increase.
Enabled a highly efficient Windows Desktop Application utilizing C# and .NET to automate Word-to-Excel and PDF conversions, saving 15+ hours per week for the operations team.
